methods_quotes.q: Cases involving e-cigarettes were identified using generic codes; brands were identified using product codes.
The percentages reported by brand represent the number of exposures for each brand out of the total number of exposures where brand was reported.
Missing or incomplete data are excluded in the percentage values for age.
